description: Peshawar Zalmi secured their second PSL title, their first since 2017, by defeating Hyderabad Kingsmen in the final. Captain Babar Azam finally lifted a trophy as leader, while Aaron Hardie starred with both bat and ball, scoring an unbeaten 56 and taking 4 wickets to guide Zalmi to victory.
title: PSL final: Mohsin Naqvi hands trophy as Babar Azam lifts first T20 title as captain

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: US President Donald Trump launched 'Project Freedom' to aid commercial ships stranded in the Strait of Hormuz, citing humanitarian concerns and low supplies.  He stated the US will guide vessels safely out, emphasizing these ships belong to nations uninvolved in regional disputes. Trump also revealed positive discussions with Iran, though he rejected their latest proposal for conflict resolution.
title: More Strait talks: Trump rolls out 'Project Freedom' to guide ships through Hormuz

author: Agencies
description: Iran has received a US response to its 30-day peace proposal, conveyed via Pakistan. The offer aims to end the ongoing war, not just extend a ceasefire, and suggests delaying nuclear talks until after hostilities cease. The US President expressed doubt about the proposal's success, citing Iran's past actions.
title: Middle East crisis: Iran proposes 30-day plan to end war, says it has received US reply

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A bulk carrier was attacked by small craft near Iran's coast in the Strait of Hormuz, with all crew reported safe and no environmental impact. This incident occurs amidst heightened tensions as the US enforces a counter-blockade on Iranian ports and plans to guide ships through the strait, drawing a strong warning from Tehran.
title: Tensions intensify at Strait: Cargo ship sailing near Hormuz attacked by Iran

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: AWS CEO Matt Garman views the AI-driven 'SaaSpocalypse' as a major business opportunity, not a threat.  He highlighted the rise of agentic AI reshaping work and announced new AI-powered tools like the Quick desktop app, aiming to revolutionize personal productivity.  AWS is also deepening its OpenAI partnership, integrating advanced AI models into its cloud services to meet surging demand.
title: As many say software is dead, Amazon Web Services CEO Matt Garman calls it a 'huge ...'

author: SUMIT ROY
description: Popular streamer Lacy's live broadcast took a dramatic turn when police pulled over his car and arrested him mid-stream. Viewers watched in real-time as officers questioned him about golf clubs in his vehicle, with unconfirmed reports suggesting they might be stolen. Lacy also faces a reckless driving charge. The incident, captured live, has gone viral across social media platforms.
title: Lacy streamer arrest: Viral moment during live driving stream in LA

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Analysts are bullish on Bajaj Finance, IIFL Finance, and Navin Fluorine, citing strong quarterly results and positive future outlooks. Federal Bank is seen as fairly valued, while Waaree Engineering's revenue beat expectations despite margin concerns. Investors are watching these key companies closely.
title: Bajaj Finance, Waaree Engineering & more: Top stocks to watch today

author: TNN
description: Canada's intelligence agency has listed India and China among nations involved in foreign interference. While acknowledging historical covert actions by India, the report highlights Khalistan extremism as a significant national security threat to Canada. This comes amid efforts to mend ties between Ottawa and New Delhi, with the latest report notably downplaying previous accusations against India.
title: Canadian intelligence agency accuses India of interference, spying

author: TNN
description: Punjab's political landscape is heating up as rival factions, led by AAP MP Raghav Chadha and CM Bhagwant Mann, are set to meet the President. The dispute centers on alleged defections and police actions, with Chadha planning to highlight a "political vendetta" following FIRs against fellow MP Sandeep Pathak. BJP has also voiced concerns over alleged retaliation.
title: Team Chadha to get audience with Murmu ahead of Mann

author: ANUJA JAISWAL
description: A 14-year-old Sudanese boy received a life-saving heart transplant in Delhi, thanks to a donor heart flown from Haryana. The organ came from a 41-year-old woman declared brain dead, whose family bravely consented to donation.
title: Heart donated in Panchkula gives Sudanese teen in Delhi new life

author: AMARJEET SINGH
description: A two-year-old boy miraculously survived nearly 20 hours alone in a wild animal-infested forest after his father allegedly murdered his mother and abandoned him. Found weak and dehydrated by police, the toddler's incredible resilience in the face of extreme danger has stunned authorities. The father has been arrested, and the child is recovering.
title: Abandoned in forest, 2-year-old walks for 20 hours, survives

author: DWAIPAYAN DATTA
description: Jasprit Bumrah is shouldering a heavy workload for Mumbai Indians in the IPL, struggling to deliver wickets while bowling defensively and attacking. Despite MI's dismal performance and Bumrah's fatigue, coach Mahela Jayawardene is reluctant to rest him, citing mathematical possibilities. This approach echoes past decisions that led to Bumrah's injury and significant absences for India.
title: Will Mumbai Indians allow Jasprit Bumrah the rest he badly needs?

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Shakib Al Hasan said he is ready to return to Bangladesh and face ongoing legal cases if assured “normal security” and protection from harassment. The former captain, absent from Bangladesh since May 2024, also revealed his bank account has been frozen during investigations. Shakib denied wrongdoing in multiple cases and said authorities have found no evidence against him so far.
title: ‘My bank account has been frozen’: Shakib reveals condition for B'desh return
